summary: Iteration 11 testing complete – 4 feature drop validated. Backend pytest: 19/20 passed (95%) with 1 failure on 'scheduled+past-date' visibility (business-logic mismatch with spec). Frontend Playwright: 100% – Why section (6 pillars), HomeFaq (8 items, accordion single-open), Blog list/filter/detail/back-link, Buchung 4-package selector + booking POST → 200 OK booking_success shown, regression on /, /fahrschule-einsiedeln, /ablauf, /vku, /impressum, /datenschutz all pass. Cleanup performed.

minor.issue: Spec says: a post with status='scheduled' and scheduled_publish_at in the PAST should be VISIBLE in the public listing. Current _is_post_published() (server.py:1094) only returns True when status=='published'. As a result, posts left in status='scheduled' never auto-promote; an admin must manually flip status to 'published'. Either fix the predicate to: published OR (scheduled AND past), OR add a background job that flips status on publish_at.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid='blog-back-link'] is hidden behind the fixed site-header when at the top of the page. Playwright click was intercepted by <header data-testid='site-header'>. Functional impact is small (link is reachable by scroll), but a sticky-header offset (scroll-margin-top or pt-24) on the post container would prevent the overlap.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Cause: visual-editor decorator span injected into the <option> element on the location <select>. No functional break; floods console with warnings on every page load. Wrap option labels in a way that bypasses decorator injection or strip the wrapping span for option children.

Uses browser-native <input type='date'> (per spec acceptable), but no client-side messaging when the user enters today's date or a past date. Browser-native validation 'Value must be 06/30/2026 or later.' fires only on submit and is locale-dependent. Consider a shadcn calendar with min={today}+1 to align with the rest of the design system.

action_items: Decide on scheduled-post auto-publish semantics and either (a) update _is_post_published to also accept status='scheduled' AND scheduled_publish_at<=now, or (b) document that scheduling is an admin-assist-only feature (status remains 'scheduled' until manually flipped).
Fix React hydration warning on /buchung <select><option> by removing the editor decorator span wrapping option text.
Add scroll-margin-top or top padding to BlogPost so the back-link is not hidden under the fixed header.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1094 _is_post_published mixes two responsibilities (status gate + time gate). Per the iteration spec a status='scheduled' post whose publish_at is in the past SHOULD be public – the current implementation contradicts the spec.

server.py:1260 update_booking accepts a raw Dict[str,Any] payload and whitelists only {'status','admin_note'}. Good defensive pattern, but there is no enum validation on status (could store arbitrary strings like 'foo'). Add Literal['pending','confirmed','cancelled','completed'] on a Pydantic model.

BuchungPage selection state is conveyed exclusively by CSS class (border-[#ff5a36] -translate-y-1 shadow-lg) and visible 'AUSGEWAHLT' text but lacks aria-pressed / role='radio'. A11y improvement: render packages as a radiogroup or add aria-pressed='true|false' so screen readers and tests can read the state.

Hydration warning on /buchung options is caused by the visual-editor wrapping <option> text in <span style={display:contents}> – HTML spec forbids non-text children of <option>. Same pattern may exist for any other <option>/<title>/<textarea> in this project; sweep all such elements.

Sitemap correctly excludes future-scheduled posts via _is_post_published reuse – but because of the same scheduled-vs-published mismatch, sitemap will also under-include posts that admin intended to auto-publish in the past.
BlogList filter chips correctly drive ?category=… in URL (deep-linkable). Good.

Booking endpoint snapshots package_snapshot at create-time – nice for historical pricing. Snapshot does NOT include features_de/features_en/duration_min though; if Nadine ever changes a package, the booking confirmation email (when built) might lose context. Consider snapshotting the full pkg doc minus _id.

rca of the issue: Single backend test failed: test_scheduled_future_hidden_past_visible. Repro: POST /api/blog with status='scheduled' & scheduled_publish_at=<future ISO> → not in GET /api/blog (correct). PATCH scheduled_publish_at to a past ISO, status stays 'scheduled' → still NOT in GET /api/blog (expected: IS in list per spec). Root cause: server.py:1097 `if doc.get('status') != 'published': return False` – the function never inspects time when status is 'scheduled'. Mitigation: change predicate to `status=='published' OR (status=='scheduled' AND scheduled_publish_at<=now)`. Alternatively run a scheduler that promotes 'scheduled'→'published' when time passes. Either change is one-liner with no schema migration.
